connect_orchestrator_helper: create an OrchestratorHelper instance and call connect to establish a connection to the orchestrator server using robot_id or hostname
request_and_complete_work_unit: request a work unit from the orchestrator server, start execution, then complete it with an outcome and optional success score
render_visual_overlay: create visual overlay renderers for a work unit, add overlay objects like circles, and render the overlay onto an image
manage_robot_info_and_events: get current robot info, set the operator ID, update hardware config, and record operator events like battery level
upload_artifact_and_manage_workcell_stat: upload a text log artifact, retrieve artifact metadata by ID, and load or set the RUI workcell state for a robot
